page.content:
Cookie Guy is a Candy Person that makes his first appearance in "Apple Thief" when he's sitting at a table in the Candy Tavern. He appears to be angry and/or straining for no apparent reason.

page.overview:
Who is Cookie Guy?

A monstrous version of Cookie Guy appears in "The Winter King". He was corrupted by the madness projected onto the Candy Queen and her people. He was killed by Fionna, who thought he was a monster.
